referee_caveats_inferred: Excitation temperature equals T_CMB assumption relies on literature density and kinetic temperature, not tested here
Flare variability factor of two comes from other molecules and is applied as a fixed 0.5 S_i term
Orion A N-PDF borrowed for a cosmological absorber with no direct check
Final T_CMB only uses the central component; choice of velocity range could bias result
Covering factor prior of 0.90–1.00 is uniform and fixed, though fc varies with time and frequency
Four datasets from different epochs and instrument setups combined without cross-calibration check stated
Tension between RADEX anomaly and LTE assumption is dismissed rather than resolved
